messages:
Alex: Heads up — can we compress next week's RFC slot into a 90m sync? Thinking a compact format: 4 authors, 12min lightning + 5min Q per slot, 10m final triage. Who can do a 6‑minute author brief (high level) vs needs full 12?
Maria: I can do a 6m brief if someone on the call can dive into the perf numbers.
Chen: I need the full 12, sorry — got a bunch of architecture detail to show.
Devbot: Poll created: https://polls.internal/redwood/agenda-order — please vote by EOD.
Jamie: timezone note: prefer earlier for EMEA folks, 9:30am PT works for me.
Sam: I'll pair-review Chen so Chen can go short if needed — happy to cover deep questions. :raised_hands:
Priyanka: Can we add a short "model eval checklist" to each pre-read? Small template so reviewers know what to scan.
Alex: yes — adding checklist to pre-read doc now. Template:```- target metrics (latency, mem, tokens/sec)
- perf regression risks
- quant/precision changes
- eval prompts + script link
- blocking issues to decide at triage```
Maria: pre-read uploaded: https://docs.google.com/shortlink/pre-reads/maria-rfc — marked as "6m brief" in the doc.
Chen: uploaded mine too: https://docs.google.com/shortlink/chen-rfc — labelled "12m full".
Alex: timeline proposal: 9:30 start, slot order = (1) Maria (brief + Sam deep), (2) Chen (full), (3) Priyanka (brief + open discussion), (4) TBD (fast‑lane). Final 10m triage.
Jamie: +1 to order, can we reserve a 10m buffer between 2 and 3 in case Chen runs over?
Alex: yes — built in a 5m buffer after slot 2 and 5m before triage.
Sam: I'll be the designated deep‑dive reviewer for Maria's brief and can jump in for Chen if needed.
Priyanka: I'll add the model eval section to my doc and link eval script. Also adding a short list of prompts to sanity check.
Devbot: Calendar invite updated with poll results and Zoom link. Reminder set for 24h before.
Chen: Quick Q @Alex — do we want slides or just a short live demo for the full slot?
Alex: Slides + 1 demo if useful. Keep slides to ~6 slides max.
Maria: noted. I'll trim mine.
Alex: Final ask: authors please add TL;DR at top of pre-read (1–2 bullets) and mark any hard blockers that need a decision in the triage. I'll pin the final agenda tomorrow AM after poll closes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
